tracking_urls.observation_label: supplied tracking template; not a simulated resolved ad click

capture.location_policy: same execution region for both roles; record observed region when available; no guarantee of nationwide parity
capture.retry_policy: retry only ordinary transient failures; rechecks are shared by evidence need; preserve attempts and stop at the total entry deadline
capture.readiness_policy: relevant rendered content or explicit valid no-offer state; networkidle or dollar presence alone is insufficient

surfaces.relevant_iframes_and_shadow_roots: only necessary primary headline/card content; no supporting-detail exploration

capture.visual_evidence_policy: Read primary image-based headline/card facts when text extraction cannot; screenshots alone do not prove readability. Do not visually audit supporting fine print.
capture.coverage_failure_result: Needs Review only for unavailable pages, necessary unreadable headline content, or no identifiable comparable offer. Supporting-detail failures never block Match; independent confirmed headline differences establish Mismatch.
capture.interaction_policy: Read primary headline/cards and relevant product tabs or headline-offer selectors only. Do not open terms, FAQs, disclosures, or supporting details to complete an offer.
capture.surface_flags_meaning: Only true headline-navigation surfaces may be inspected; false detail/terms/FAQ/disclosure surfaces must not be opened.

gap_assessment.uncertain_relevance: Only necessary unreadable primary headline content or an unidentifiable comparable offer blocks. A possible condition/code in supporting details is outside scope.

scheduling.whole_pass_barriers: only for genuine evidence dependencies; otherwise enqueue ready work

sessions.idle_retention: bounded by available page slots and the existing cumulative entry budget; release if retaining would block ready work
sessions.on_reopen: restore only necessary headline/product-tab prerequisites; capture missing primary state; repeat baseline only when invalidated

actions.disabled_control: skip action in current observed state; assess only necessary headline coverage
actions.obstruction_recovery: identify obstruction, dismiss if appropriate, verify state changed; remain within existing shared retry/recheck budgets
actions.order: select required product/device headline view; never intentionally open terms, FAQs, supporting panels, or disclosures
actions.completion: explicit expected selected product/tab and readable associated primary headline/card content
actions.carousel_stop: required headline offers already captured, disabled control, repeated state, or no new primary offers
actions.modal_policy: dismiss unsolicited obstructing overlays safely and verify closure; do not open disclosure modals or inspect their terms

scrolling.missing_bottom_confirmation: not an automatic blocker; assess only necessary primary headline/card content

telemetry.clock: monotonic elapsed durations plus UTC event timestamps
telemetry.offer_state_coverage_definition: headline/card/product-tab coverage only; supporting terms are excluded

provenance.unknown_runner_version: record unknown; do not claim runtime policy enforcement

benchmark.selection_source: exact prior 25-record manifest and pinned inventory from the sandbox run
benchmark.scope_change_notice: Old broader-scope runs are not equivalent-work baselines unless comparable headline coverage can be established from saved evidence. Preserve originals and explain scope differences; do not automatically relabel them.

status_rules.Mismatch: A headline price or offer differs, or an advertised offer is absent from the corresponding readable page.
status_rules.Needs Review: A page is unavailable, necessary headline content cannot be read, or there is no identifiable comparable offer.

comparison.field_selection: Extract in-scope primary fields rather than comparing raw full-card text; ignore excluded clauses even when adjacent.
comparison.unreadable_necessary_headline: Needs Review unless an independent confirmed headline mismatch establishes Mismatch
comparison.location_label_only: nonblocking; compare observed headlines without ZIP entry
comparison.headline_offer_absence: Mismatch only when absent from an identifiable corresponding readable page; unreadable content is not absence

disabled_checks.advertised_requirements: out_of_scope; skip as internal NOT_APPLICABLE, never a missing check or public blocker
